FieldReady Academy

BMET Training Course for the AAMI CABT (Biomed Training Course)

BMET Academy is a free biomed training course for people starting out in healthcare technology management. Fifty-three lessons and thirteen hands-on labs on virtual instruments double as a CABT study guide, and the practice tests lead up to the AAMI/ACI Certified Associate in Biomedical Technology exam.

The exam at a glance

ExamAAMI / ACI Certified Associate in Biomedical Technology
CodeCABT
Questions100
Time120 minutes
PassingACI reports CABT results only as pass or fail and publishes no passing score. This course's official-format test uses 70%, the same bar as our CBET course.
Course53 lessons across 8 units, 13 labs, about 8.1 hours of reading
CostFree

How the course works

  1. Cheat sheet. Everything the exam expects you to recall cold, printable.
  2. Starter test. A few questions per exam domain, with a confidence rating on each.
  3. Your tutorial. Lessons chosen from what you missed or guessed, each with a checkpoint and a deeper explanation.
  4. Practice tests and retraining. 50 questions, weighted like the real exam. Every miss is explained and feeds back into your lessons.
  5. 3 of your last 5 at 80%. That unlocks one full-length test on the real exam's clock: 100 questions in 120 minutes, at its real passing score of 70%. Pass it once and you are ready to book.

How the virtual safety analyzer lab works

Questions people ask

What is the CABT?

The Certified Associate in Biomedical Technology is the entry-level AAMI/ACI credential for biomedical equipment technicians: 100 questions in 2 hours, closed book, taken by live remote proctoring any time of year, valid five years.

Who can take the CABT exam?

Anyone who is at least a high school junior. No work experience is required, which is what makes it the first credential for a new technician.

How much does the CABT cost?

In 2026 the exam is $220 for AAMI members and $270 for non-members; a retake is $190 or $240 after a 60-day wait. The fee is non-refundable and the exam must be taken within six months of purchase.

Do I need a lab kit?

No. Every kit lab also runs on the virtual multimeter in the browser. A kit of a multimeter, breadboard, resistors, a 9 V battery, LEDs, a switch, and a fuse holder costs about $60 to $100 if you want the hands-on version.

Is BMET Academy free?

Yes. Every lesson, lab, practice test, and the printable memorization sheet are free while the site launches.

What comes after the CABT?

The CBET, the working technician's credential, after two years of full-time work with an associate degree or a military biomed program, or four years of work alone; then the CRES for imaging or the CHTM for managers.
